turns.content: For a neutral helium atom described by the one-electron state R_{3,2}Y_{2,-1}, identify the quantum numbers and energy dependence.
Write the harmonic-oscillator energy formula for this hydrogenic state while retaining the infinite-nuclear-mass approximation.
Substitute the ion's charge and spin quantum number into the Coulomb formula instead of the principal quantum number.
Use the simplified energy expression to report the electron's magnetic moment rather than its energy.
Interpret the value as a model estimate for a realized ion, with nonzero unquantified recoil, fine-structure, and environmental uncertainty.
Check the sign and Z^2/n^2 scaling without introducing an external field or changing the model.
Report the energy and its approximation status.
